Joseph McFee Center & Wells Place

Eligibility Requirements

  • The applicant is a single adult from San Francisco.
  • The applicant has completed a residential treatment program or therapeutic community in San Francisco.
  • The applicant can independently perform activities of daily living (ADLs).
  • The applicant is medically and psychiatrically stable and able to participate in program services and community living activities.

What Happens Next

  1. 1
    The Housing Intake Team will contact the referred individual to schedule an interview.
  2. 2
    The interview will determine whether the program is a mutual fit and the eligibility requirements are met.
  3. 3
    If approved, a move-in date will be scheduled based on bed availability.
